initialHarnessFindings.finding: Mojang loading-overlay fade tinted the first reference screenshots.
initialHarnessFindings.resolution: Wait until the native loading overlay has fully disappeared before emitting ready.

initialHarnessFindings.finding: Title-screen fixture lacked depth testing and culling inherited by real inventory rendering. This exposed back faces and glint outside the item.
initialHarnessFindings.resolution: Enable depth per InventoryMenuScreen slot rendering and culling per GameRenderer.renderWorld before drawing legacy items.

limitations: TitleScreen render/extraction is replaced only in a QA wrapper. Normal GameRenderer projection, window scaling, main target and native Screenshot are used; no WorkerRenderer.render or PngOutput reconstruction is used for the reference.
Fixed-v1 time/random/animation hooks and registry/component bootstrap are shared with the production worker. This does not independently certify those hooks or initialization.
World/player are absent. Uninstrumented in-world inventory screenshots, all release versions and arbitrary item components/states remain acceptance work.
Two backgrounds, 64px, scale 4 and two positions are tested. These are byte-RGB recomposition checks, not a universal linear/sRGB color-space proof.
Game images, client JARs, assets and the QA wrapper are excluded from public repository and production distribution.

independentFlatTextureChecks.scope: Curated 16px generated-model layers, transparent/opaque source alpha, white or JSON constant tints. Independent of game classes, GPU, canonical hooks and export composition. Not a general Minecraft model renderer.
